acceptedAnswer.text: Interior home renovation costs in Irvine or Huntington Beach can vary widely. Factors include the size of the space, the quality of materials selected, and the complexity of the design. A basic bathroom remodel might start around $15,000, while a high-end kitchen can exceed $70,000. Whole-home renovations often start from $75,000 and go upward. We provide detailed estimates after a consultation to align with your budget and vision.
